question.problem:
Calculate the minor of the entry $b_{21}$ in the matrix
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14273095/assets/400153db7dff8c577f5ff0b17666f6091671b0639ce4a1961300ea0a0a8aed03.svg)
question.worked_solution:
The minor of $b_{21} = 3$ (second row, first column) is the determinant of the remaining entries when the column and row containing $3$ are removed: 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14273095/assets/d7e66e344c433fbf64a88132c044dd5fd30eb5f769b434ea1d631e53ae30fe36.svg)

So, the minor of $b_{21}=3$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}det[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 7 & 2\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 7 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot 2-5\cdot 7 \\  & =2-35 \\  & =-33.\end{aligned}
$$
